title: On Weeping for an hour in the barn
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：weep　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 weep 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the driver ① wept for an hour in the barn in public, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the driver ② weeps for an hour in the barn in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ weep for an hour in the barn at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ wept for an hour in the barn before — a line in the timetable for February 1967 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Weeping for an hour in the barn in public, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ weep over the letter from the south in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Weep over the letter from the south at once and never mention it again.

By 1980 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the timetable, and a new passenger from the next station ⑧ weeps over the letter from the south in public every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the platform, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ wept for an hour in the barn again when nobody else would.

⑩ To weep for an hour in the barn, my mother said in 1985, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody weeps for an hour in the barn in silence again and somebody must weep for an hour in the barn in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 哭泣（一般过去式 wept for an hour in the barn：1973 年司机头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 哭泣（一般现在 weeps for an hour in the barn：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 哭泣（不定式 to weep for an hour in the barn：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 哭泣（过去完成时 had wept for an hour in the barn：1967 年二月的时刻表上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 哭泣（动名词 weeping for an hour in the barn 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 为…流泪（weep over the letter from the south：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去为…流泪为那封南来的信落泪）
G. v. 为…流泪（weep over the letter from the south：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 哭泣（后段两处：新来的乘客照例 weeps over the letter from the south，而母亲又一次 wept for an hour in the barn）

weep 意为“哭泣”，自那以后司机一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 weeps。
weep 意为“哭泣”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯哭泣在谷仓里哭了一个钟头”，此处为不定式 to weep for an hour in the barn。
weep 意为“哭泣”，时刻表里 二月 那行字说明早在 1980 年之前就有人哭泣过，故用过去完成时 had wept。
weep 意为“哭泣”，司机说“哭泣在谷仓里哭了一个钟头这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 weeping for an hour in the barn 作主语。
weep 意为“为…流泪”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去为…流泪为那封南来的信落泪”，should ever 之后用原形 weep over the letter from the south。
weep 意为“为…流泪”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻为…流泪为那封南来的信落泪（weep over the letter from the south at once），以后再也不要提起。
weep 意为“哭泣”，新来的乘客每个日子都照例为…流泪为那封南来的信落泪，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 weeps。
weep 意为“哭泣”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面哭泣在谷仓里哭了一个钟头，用一般过去式 wept 叙述。
weep 意为“哭泣”，结尾那句是母亲 1985 年的话：要哭泣在谷仓里哭了一个钟头，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车站记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 weep 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the driver wept for an hour in the barn in public, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the driver weeps for an hour in the barn in silence whenever the station asks.
Weeping for an hour in the barn in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever weep over the letter from the south in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new passenger from the next station weeps over the letter from the south in public every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother wept for an hour in the barn again, and the station remembered that half.
